records.en_original: One day during summer vacation, I suddenly found myself in this strange world. There, I met a few other girls who are around my age.^00^00This world is connected to another world, which we call "the Faraway." To gather the things we need to survive, and to solve the mysteries of this world, we started exploring the Faraway as part of our daily routine.^00^00...Seriously, what the heck is this place?! [memo]Collect ingredients

records.jp: やれることはやった。^00後は、ちゃんと新しい世界が創られるのを待つだけ。^00ここでみんなと過ごせる時間も、もう残り少ない。^00 ^00もし今日世界が終わるとしたら……なんて妄想は^00何度もしたことがある。^00でも、それが現実になる日が来るなんてね。^00最後の一日は、どうやって過ごそうかな[memo]最後の日を過ごす相手を決めよう
records.en_original: We did all we could. Now we just have to wait for the new world to be built. And we don't have much time left in this place anyway.^00^00I always thought about what I'd do if I knew the world was ending... And now that day is here. All there's left to do now is to decide how I'll spend my final day here. [memo]Choose who to spend your final day with
records.en: We did all we could. Now we just have to wait for the new world to be built. And we don't have much time left in this place anyway.^00^00I always thought about what I'd do if I knew the world was ending... And now that day is here. All there's left to do now is to decide how I'll spend my final day here. [memo]Choose who to spend your final day with

records.jp: 遠くに島が見えた。^00あんなところに島なんてなかった……はず。^00ユズとライムも想定外だって言ってたし、^00行ってみるっきゃないか。^00桟橋へ急ごう！[memo]桟橋に向かおう
records.en_original: We saw an island off in the distance. I don't think it was there before... Yuzu and Lime called it "unexpected" too, so I guess we just have to go check it out. To the pier! [memo]Head to the pier
records.en: We saw an island off in the distance. I don't think it was there before... Yuzu and Lime called it "unexpected" too, so I guess we just have to go check it out. To the pier! [memo]Head to the pier

records.jp: 待機組も気分転換を兼ねて一緒に行くことに。^00危ない場所かもしれないけど、^00今の私たちならなんとかなる……たぶん！^00^00到着した島はまるで南国のリゾート！^00なんて思ってたら影がどこからか現れて、^00何も言わず島の奥へ消えて行った。^00ん～気になる。追いかけてみよう！[memo]影の少女を追いかけよう
records.en_original: The other girls decided to come along too, just to shake things up. It could be a little dangerous, but we're totally capable of taking on whatever comes our way...I think!^00^00The island looks just like a tropical resort! Or so we thought. A shadow appeared out of nowhere, then just walked off without saying a word. Better see where it went! [memo]Go after the shadow girl
records.en: The other girls decided to come along too, just to shake things up. It could be a little dangerous, but we're totally capable of taking on whatever comes our way...I think!^00^00The island looks just like a tropical resort! Or so we thought. A shadow appeared out of nowhere, then just walked off without saying a word. Better see where it went! [memo]Go after the shadow girl

records.jp: 影の話によると、^00この島は私たちの葛藤から生まれたらしい。^00あと、モンスターを生み出す悪い想いを持った影がいて、^00放っておくと学校にもモンスターがやってくるとか。^00悪い想いの影が守っている、^00宝珠を持ってくればなんとかなるらしいから、^00宝珠のある東へ行ってみよう[memo]影から宝珠を入手しよう
records.en_original: According to the shadow, this island was created from our conflicts. Also, there are also some shadows with negative emotions that create demons. They'll even start sending demons to the school if we don't deal with them.^00Apparently those shadows have these orbs, and they'll go away if we get the orbs. So first we need to go to the east and find one. [memo]Get an orb from a shadow
records.en: According to the shadow, this island was created from our conflicts. Also, there are also some shadows with negative emotions that create demons. They'll even start sending demons to the school if we don't deal with them.^00Apparently those shadows have these orbs, and they'll go away if we get the orbs. So first we need to go to the east and find one. [memo]Get an orb from a shadow

records.jp: 襲い掛かってきたモンスター達、^00さっきのダルそうな影が生み出したんだよね。^00感情がネガティブに振り切れてたけど、^00想いが形になった影響なのかな。^00まあとりあえず宝珠は手に入ったし、頂上の広場に戻るか[memo]頂上の広場で宝珠を入手したことを報告しよう
records.en_original: The demons that attacked us were created by the lazy shadow we saw just now. Our feelings turned negative too, but that must have been the effect of the shadow.^00Well, at least we got an orb. Guess we should get back to the clearing up top. [memo]Go back to the clearing and tell the shadow about the orb
records.en: The demons that attacked us were created by the lazy shadow we saw just now. Our feelings turned negative too, but that must have been the effect of the shadow.^00Well, at least we got an orb. Guess we should get back to the clearing up top. [memo]Go back to the clearing and tell the shadow about the orb

records.jp: 宝珠を台座に捧げると、太陽がみるみる隠れて雨空に。^00これで他の宝珠がある場所にも行けるようになったらしい。^00頂上にいる影が指し示したのは西。^00よし、行ってみよう[memo]影から宝珠を入手しよう
records.en_original: We put the orb into the pedestal, and rain clouds suddenly appeared, blocking out the sun. That'll let us get to other places where we can find the orbs.^00The shadow told us to head west, so off we go! [memo]Get an orb from a shadow
records.en: We put the orb into the pedestal, and rain clouds suddenly appeared, blocking out the sun. That'll let us get to other places where we can find the orbs.^00The shadow told us to head west, so off we go! [memo]Get an orb from a shadow

records.jp: 宝珠を守ってた影は本当に悪い想いだったのかな。^00モンスターが現れたのは事実。^00でも、ただ遊びたがってるだけに見えたし……^00頂上の広場へ宝珠を持って行くついでに、^00もうちょっと詳しく聞いてみよう[memo]頂上の広場で宝珠を入手したことを報告しよう
records.en_original: I wonder if the shadow that had this orb really was bad. We did run into a demon, but it looked like it just wanted to play...^00I'll have to ask more about that when we bring this orb up to the clearing. [memo]Go back to the clearing and tell the shadow about the orb
records.en: I wonder if the shadow that had this orb really was bad. We did run into a demon, but it looked like it just wanted to play...^00I'll have to ask more about that when we bring this orb up to the clearing. [memo]Go back to the clearing and tell the shadow about the orb

records.jp: 頂上にいる影は、目的のため頑張らなきゃっていう想い。^00宝珠を守っている影は、ただ単純に遊びたいという想い。^00それらがぶつかり合って、^00この島やモンスターを生み出してるらしい。^00頂上の影は自分だけが正しいって思ってるみたいだけど、^00もう一方の話も聞いてみたいな。^00最後の宝珠がある場所には、また別の影がいるはず。^00宝珠の元へ向かおう[memo]最後の宝珠の元へ向かおう
records.en_original: The shadow in the clearing was made from the feeling of having to push yourself to achieve something, whereas the shadow that had the orb came from the feeling of just wanting to play. This island and the demons were created because of their conflict. The shadow in the clearing seems to think that her way of thinking is the only right way, but I want to hear the other side of the story.^00There's one more shadow where the last orb is. We'd better make our way there. [memo]Head to the last orb
records.en: The shadow in the clearing was made from the feeling of having to push yourself to achieve something, whereas the shadow that had the orb came from the feeling of just wanting to play. This island and the demons were created because of their conflict. The shadow in the clearing seems to think that her way of thinking is the only right way, but I want to hear the other side of the story.^00There's one more shadow where the last orb is. We'd better make our way there. [memo]Head to the last orb

records.jp: 最後の宝珠は手に入った。^00けど、私たちの正解はまだ見つかってない。^00というわけで影も入れて全員で学級会だ！^00仲直りのために話し合うんじゃなくて、^00お互いの大切を見極めるために想いをぶつけ合うべき。^00頂上の広場へ向かおう[memo]頂上の広場に向かおう
records.en_original: We got the last orb. But I'm still not sure what the right thing to do is. So we're all gonna have a meeting, including the shadows!^00Rather than talk about how we can all get along, they should share their feelings so they can understand what's important to each other.^00Back to the clearing again! [memo]Head to the clearing
records.en: We got the last orb. But I'm still not sure what the right thing to do is. So we're all gonna have a meeting, including the shadows!^00Rather than talk about how we can all get along, they should share their feelings so they can understand what's important to each other.^00Back to the clearing again! [memo]Head to the clearing

教室でくつろいでいたら、^00突如新しいココロトープが出現した。^00フリスぺの通知は歯抜けだし……。^00何が引き金となって接続されたんだろう？^00ひとまず、見に行ってみよう[memo]新しく出てきた謎のココロトープに向かおう
records.en_original: A Heartscape appeared out of nowhere while we were hanging out in the classroom. And the FreeSpace notification we got was all glitchy... I wonder what could've triggered it?^00First things first, we have to go check it out. [memo]Head to the mysterious new Heartscape
records.en: A Heartscape appeared out of nowhere while we were hanging out in the classroom. And the FreeSpace notification we got was all glitchy... I wonder what could've triggered it?^00First things first, we have to go check it out. [memo]Head to the mysterious new Heartscape

records.jp: 新しく出てきたココロトープは、^00なんだかこの世のものとは思えない不思議な雰囲気。^00そして『クーケン島』に『王都』。^00ラノベに出てきそうな単語に^00思わずテンションが上がっちゃった！^00さあ、冒険の始まりだ！[memo]ライザさんのココロトープを探索しよう
records.en_original: The new Heartscape has a mystical feel to it, like it's a completely different world. And with things like "Kurken Island" and "the capital," it's like something out of a fantasy novel!^00This is getting really exciting. Let the adventure begin! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape
records.en: The new Heartscape has a mystical feel to it, like it's a completely different world. And with things like "Kurken Island" and "the capital," it's like something out of a fantasy novel!^00This is getting really exciting. Let the adventure begin! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape

records.jp: このココロトープの主、ライザさんは^00『錬金術士』らしい。^00錬金術なんて歴史でしか聞いたことはないし……。^00もしかして異世界とつながっていたりするのかな？^00そうだとしたらますます興味が出てきた[memo]ライザさんのココロトープを探索しよう
records.en_original: Ryza, the person who the new Heartscape belongs to, is apparently an alchemist! I've only heard of alchemy in history books... Maybe we've connected to a different world somehow.^00The plot continues to thicken! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape
records.en: Ryza, the person who the new Heartscape belongs to, is apparently an alchemist! I've only heard of alchemy in history books... Maybe we've connected to a different world somehow.^00The plot continues to thicken! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape

records.jp: ライザさんのココロトープを探索していると、^00行く手を巨大な骨に阻まれてしまった。^00その時現れたライザさんの影によると、^00釜を使って道具を調合すれば道が開けるらしい。^00こうなったら私たちも錬金術に挑戦だ！^00形から入るのは大事！　ということで、^00錬金術に必要なもの、作ってみよう！[memo]錬金術に必要なものを作ろう
records.en_original: While we were exploring Ryza's Heartscape, we stumbled upon a huge bone blocking our path. Ryza's shadow appeared then, and told us that we could use a cauldron to create a tool that would clear the way. Which means that we get to be alchemists too! I don't know if it'll work, but we just have to try.^00So, first things first: Make what we need to do get our alchemy on! [memo]Make what is required for alchemy
records.en: While we were exploring Ryza's Heartscape, we stumbled upon a huge bone blocking our path. Ryza's shadow appeared then, and told us that we could use a cauldron to create a tool that would clear the way. Which means that we get to be alchemists too! I don't know if it'll work, but we just have to try.^00So, first things first: Make what we need to do get our alchemy on! [memo]Make what is required for alchemy

records.jp: 無事に錬金釜は完成！^00……でも、本当にこれで錬金術ができるのかな？^00とにかく、これに材料を投入して何が起きるか……。^00さっそく試してみよう！[memo]錬金釜に素材を投入しよう
records.en_original: We finished making the cauldron! ...But I don't know if we'll actually be able to use it to do alchemy. Guess there's only one way to find out: Dump some materials in it and see what happens! [memo]Put materials into the cauldron
records.en: We finished making the cauldron! ...But I don't know if we'll actually be able to use it to do alchemy. Guess there's only one way to find out: Dump some materials in it and see what happens! [memo]Put materials into the cauldron

records.jp: 錬金釜を作って中に素材を投入すると、^00すごい音と振動が発生！^00きっと、ライザさんのココロトープに^00変化が起きたんだと思う。^00これで前よりももっと探索できるはず。^00さっそく向かってみよう！[memo]ライザさんのココロトープを探索しよう
records.en_original: After making the cauldron and putting some materials into it, it made a loud noise and started shaking! I think it caused a change in Ryza's Heartscape—we should be able to go deeper into it now.^00Better head over there to see! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape
records.en: After making the cauldron and putting some materials into it, it made a loud noise and started shaking! I think it caused a change in Ryza's Heartscape—we should be able to go deeper into it now.^00Better head over there to see! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape

records.jp: ライザさんのココロトープを探索することで、^00彼女の想いが伝わってきた。^00仲間と一緒に冒険をする楽しみ、^00そしてそれが終わる寂しさ。^00こうしてみると、私たちとライザさんは^00そう変わんないのかなって思う。^00ライザさんの冒険も大詰めみたいだし、^00最後までしっかり見届けよう！[memo]ライザさんのココロトープを探索しよう
records.en_original: As we explored Ryza's Heartscape, we started to understand her emotions: her joy when she went on adventures with her friends, and her sadness when it came to an end. Looking at it that way, Ryza isn't any different from any of us.^00It seems like her adventure is coming to an end, so we should go see it with our own eyes! [memo]Explore Ryza's Heartscape
